VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition
VR.summary: Meta has spun out its VR fitness app Supernatural into an independent company, promising fresh content after parting ways with its original founders.

VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are set to be sent to the International Space Station for astronaut training in a collaboration between Meta and the ESA.

VR.title: X-Plane & iRacing PC VR Streaming Clients Launched For Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, allowing users to blend physical accessories with virtual experiences.

VR.title: Supernatural To Return Under New Independent Company As Coaches Rejoin Platform
VR.summary: Supernatural will return under a new independent company as Meta hands back the IP to its original founders and coaches.

VR.title: Time-bending VR Puzzle Game UnLoop Gets Permanent Price Drop
VR.summary: The VR puzzle game UnLoop has received a permanent price drop across all supported platforms, making it more accessible.

VR.title: I Am Cat Was The Most Downloaded PlayStation VR2 Game In May
VR.summary: I Am Cat became the most downloaded game on PlayStation VR2 in May following its surprise release.

AI.title: TSMC struggles to keep up with AI demand: ‘We can only support so much’
AI.summary: TSMC is struggling to meet surging AI demand, with CEO C.C. Wei stating they can only support so much despite expanding US operations.

AI.title: Amazon develops a warehouse robot that workers can speak to
AI.summary: Amazon unveiled a new autonomous warehouse robot, Proteus, that can interact with workers using natural language instead of code.

AI.title: AI leaders call for tougher protections against AI-aided bioweapons
AI.summary: Tech leaders are urging US lawmakers to implement stricter regulations to prevent AI from being used in bioweapons development.

AI.title: AI has a water problem — Google thinks it has a fix
AI.summary: Google is addressing environmental concerns related to AI data centers by committing to enhance water availability for local communities.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced a range of new AI initiatives at its Build conference, signaling its intent to be a major player in the AI space.

AI.title: Botnet of more than 17 million devices dismantled
AI.summary: A botnet of over 17 million devices has been dismantled, reportedly linked to a Russia-based residential proxy network.

NFL.title: Dolphins sign first-round pick Chris Johnson, complete 2026 draft class
NFL.summary: The Miami Dolphins have signed first-round pick Chris Johnson, finalizing their 2026 draft class.

NFL.title: Texans sign first-round OL Keylan Rutledge
NFL.summary: The Houston Texans have signed first-round offensive lineman Keylan Rutledge to a four-year rookie contract.

NFL.title: Rams, Myles Garrett execute a new contract
NFL.summary: Myles Garrett has secured a new contract with the Rams, receiving a $6.5 million raise for the 2026 season.

NFL.title: Christian Watson, Packers agree to four-year extension
NFL.summary: Christian Watson has agreed to a four-year extension with the Packers worth $110.5 million, including $31 million guaranteed.

NFL.title: Steelers sign LB Jamin Davis
NFL.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers have signed linebacker Jamin Davis as part of their roster enhancements.

NFL.title: Brian Flores wins Halas Award from the PFWA for overcoming adversity
NFL.summary: Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores has been awarded the Halas Award for overcoming adversity.
